customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

Without choosing a date: The manager says I must pay more from next month or the lease will be terminated; There was no official form; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “formally questionable rent increase”, for an initial view: the exact delivery method remains unresolved; for the request “check whether the notice is valid”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “formally questionable rent increase”, my records may be out of order; also unresolved: which dates reliably establish the chronology; that is the basis of my request.

I am asking for: check whether the notice is valid; in particular, I need clarity about which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; Please explain the exact delivery method; Only then will I know what to do.

As far as I remember, it started around 17 January 2025.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Chronology still unclear: formally questionable rent increase
